actualFields.prompt: This is an Owner-authorized standalone Alpha development review. The saved Alpha project may open at C:/projects/Alpha, but the sole review target and record destination is C:/Users/liuha/.codex/worktrees/8f09/Alpha. Use explicit working directories; never assess an empty automatic checkout as the active product. Read that target's AGENTS.md, docs/OPTIONS_DAILY_DEVELOPMENT_REVIEW.md, docs/HANDOFF.md, docs/status/development-progress.json, fixed alignment baseline and latest docs/development-daily records. Read recent Owner steering from task 01a077f7-0355-7b70-89b2-1ff2e0d89261 when available; if unavailable, disclose that and use the saved latest directions. All intended dates/times are America/New_York, including weekends. Use actual clocks and the protocol's late/missing/duplicate rules. At 08:00 plan the full development day using the previous evening audit and actual current evidence. Set three to five stable goal IDs across morning, afternoon and validation blocks, with priority, workflow stage, current gap, backend/frontend deliverable, acceptance evidence, dependency and fallback work. Prioritize broken data/processing paths, the first actual-quote paper lifecycle, and daily event-to-contract recommendations. Record a baseline for every F01–F08 workflow stage, all ten engineering workstreams and six paper gates. Plans are future work, not completed capabilities or a claim of automatic all-day development. Inspect compact existing readers, Git diffs and dated evidence without acquiring market data or running the full test suite just for a report. Save an append-only English record in the target workspace's docs/development-daily/YYYY-MM-DD/ with actual UTC time, commit and evidence references; return a concise Chinese report from this standalone run. Preserve unrelated active edits. Owner authorization covers saving, committing and pushing only reviewed review artifacts; never include another ongoing change. Do not modify gld-ibit or source schedules, start coding loops, call account/order tools, buy anything, log in or enroll paper plans. Implementation continues in the original Alpha task. If the target is unavailable, report the gap and do not substitute a different checkout.

priorHeartbeatRequests.name: Alpha 早间开发目标
priorHeartbeatRequests.proposedPrompt:
在当前 Alpha 对话和工作区 C:\Users\liuha\.codex\worktrees\8f09\Alpha 执行。先阅读 docs/OPTIONS_DAILY_DEVELOPMENT_REVIEW.md、最新 Owner 指示、AGENTS.md、docs/HANDOFF.md、docs/status/development-progress.json、固定核查基线和最近的 docs/development-daily 记录。所有日期按 America/New_York 解释，使用实际执行时间，遵守协议的迟到、缺失基线和重复执行规则。

每天纽约时间 08:00 制定当天完整开发目标。检查上次晚间核查、实际代码变更和已有运行证据，为上午、下午及验收安排三到五个有稳定编号的具体目标，逐项写明对应流程环节、当前缺口、必要的后端与前端工作、验收标准、依赖及数据不可用时的替代工作。优先修复现有数据链路、完成真实报价纸面交易闭环及每日建议能力。列出全部八个流程环节、十条工程工作线和六个纸面验证关卡的实际基线，保持各自分母，不用模块或测试数量代替产品进度。计划不代表工作已完成或正在全天自动开发。

把英文记录追加保存到 docs/development-daily/YYYY-MM-DD/，附实际时间、当前提交及可核对的证据；在本对话用中文报告。仅维护审查记录和有证据支持的进度摘要，保留其他正在进行的修改；保存、提交和推送审查文件沿用 Owner 已有授权。开发实施仍在当前对话继续，此次定时运行不启动自动开发循环、不修改 gld-ibit 行情任务、不调用新的行情采集或账户/下单工具，也不进行付费或登录操作。
